seo.title: easywed.
seo.description: Plan table layouts, assign guests, and create the perfect wedding hall floor plan.
landing.hero.title: Every guest in the right seat
landing.hero.subtitle: Design your reception hall, arrange the tables, and seat every guest — together with your partner, right in the browser.
landing.hero.local_hint: Guest mode saves your plan on this device only — sign in later to keep it.
landing.features.title: Everything your seating chart needs
landing.features.subtitle: From the first sketch of the hall to the final printed guest list.
landing.features.planner.title: Drag & drop floor plan
landing.features.planner.desc: Round and rectangular tables, the dance floor, and fixtures — lay out the hall exactly as it will look on the day, or import your venue's DXF plan.
landing.features.guests.title: A guest list that stays organised
landing.features.guests.desc: Dietary needs, plus-ones, and seat assignments live next to every name — no more cross-checking three spreadsheets.
landing.features.import.title: Import and export in seconds
landing.features.import.desc: Bring guests in from a CSV or Excel sheet and export a clean, printable seating report for the venue.
landing.features.collab.title: Plan together
landing.features.collab.desc: Invite your partner or wedding planner — everyone sees the same plan, and changes sync instantly.
landing.features.reminders.title: Never miss a deadline
landing.features.reminders.desc: Keep wedding to-dos with dates in one place, so the final headcount doesn't sneak up on you.
landing.features.assistant.title: An assistant that seats with you
landing.features.assistant.desc: Connect your own AI key and ask the assistant to arrange tables, seat families together, or tidy up the plan.
landing.steps.title: Three steps to a finished plan

landing.steps.one.desc: Set the room dimensions or import the venue's floor plan, then place the tables.

landing.steps.two.desc: Type them in or import the list you already keep in a spreadsheet.

privacy.seo_description: How easywed. handles your data: what we collect, where it is stored, and your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: easywed. ("we", "the app", available at easywed.app) is a wedding seating planner. This policy explains what data the app processes, where it is stored, and what your choices are. The short version: your wedding plan belongs to you, we collect only what the app needs to work, and we never sell your data.
privacy.controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
privacy.controller.body: The data controller for easywed. is the operator of easywed.app. For any privacy question or request, contact us at contact.kurek@gmail.com.
privacy.data.title: What data we process
privacy.data.intro: Depending on how you use the app, we process:
privacy.data.account: Account data — your email address and password (stored as a hash), or your name and email from Google if you sign in with Google. Handled by our authentication provider, Supabase.
privacy.data.content: Wedding content you enter — wedding name and date, hall layout, tables, and your guest list, including guest names, dietary needs, and seat assignments.
privacy.data.files: Files you import — guest spreadsheets (CSV/XLSX) and venue floor plans (DXF) are parsed in your browser; only the resulting guests and layout are saved, never the file itself.
privacy.data.usage: Usage analytics — product events (pages visited, features used) and basic device information, collected via PostHog to help us improve the app.
privacy.data.local: Data stored only on your device — language, colour theme, guest-mode wedding plans, and AI assistant settings live in your browser's local storage and are never sent to our servers.
privacy.storage.title: Where your data lives
privacy.storage.body: Account data and wedding content are stored in a Postgres database managed by Supabase. Access is enforced at the database level: only members of a wedding (the owner and the people they invite) can read or change its data. The app itself is served by Cloudflare.
privacy.guest_mode.title: Guest mode (no account)
privacy.guest_mode.body: You can plan without an account. In that case the entire plan is stored in your browser's local storage on this device only — nothing is sent to our servers. Clearing browser data deletes the plan; signing in later lets you move it to your account.
privacy.ai.title: AI assistant (bring your own key)
privacy.ai.body: The assistant is optional and uses an API key you provide. Your messages and the relevant parts of your wedding plan are sent directly from your browser to the AI provider you configured — they never pass through or get stored on our servers. Your API key is kept only in your browser's local storage. The privacy policy of your chosen provider applies to those requests.
privacy.sharing.title: Who we share data with
privacy.sharing.intro: We never sell your data and share it only with the services that run the app:
privacy.sharing.google: Google — only if you choose to sign in with Google.
privacy.sharing.ai: Your chosen AI provider — only if you configure the assistant, and only directly from your browser.
privacy.guests.title: Your guests' data
privacy.guests.body: The guest names and dietary details you enter are personal data of other people. You add them for your own private purpose — planning your wedding — and we process them only to store and display your plan. Please enter only the details you need, and remove them when they are no longer needed.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.body: Under the GDPR you can access, correct, export, or delete your data at any time. Deleting a wedding removes its guests, tables, and reminders; deleting your account removes your data from our systems. For any request — or a complaint — write to contact.kurek@gmail.com. You may also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in Poland: the President of the Personal Data Protection Office, UODO).
privacy.retention.title: How long we keep data
privacy.retention.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists. When you delete a wedding or your account, the associated data is deleted from the database.
privacy.changes.title: Changes to this policy
privacy.changes.body: If we change this policy, we will update this page and the date above. Significant changes will be announced in the app.

assistant.setup.title: Connect your AI
assistant.setup.intro: The assistant uses your own AI account (bring your own key). Enter an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, key, and model.
assistant.setup.step_1: Create an account at openrouter.ai (it works with GPT, Claude, and Gemini through one key).
assistant.setup.step_2: Generate an API key and paste it above. Keep the default base URL.
assistant.setup.step_3: Pick a model id, then save and start chatting.
assistant.setup.security_note: Your key is stored in this browser's local storage only and is sent directly to your chosen provider. Don't use this on a shared computer.
assistant.setup.insecure_url: This is an unencrypted (http) address — your key will be sent in plain text. Only use http for a local server.
assistant.setup.llamacpp_intro: Run a model on your own machine with llama.cpp's server — free and private, no key needed.
assistant.setup.llamacpp_step_1: Install llama.cpp (a prebuilt binary or built from source).
assistant.setup.llamacpp_step_2: Start the server with a model that supports tool calling, e.g. run "llama-server -hf <model>".
assistant.setup.llamacpp_step_3: Use base URL http://localhost:8080/v1, any value for the key, and any model name. Save and start chatting.
assistant.setup.llamacpp_jinja: Important: the assistant can only add or move things if your model supports tool calling. If tools aren't being called, restart the server with the --jinja flag so llama.cpp uses the model's own chat template.
assistant.setup.provider_local_dev_only: The local llama.cpp option is only available in development.
